QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] The Minister's Son
QuestInfo.0: You travel to the empty house to talk to Leon Daniella, the son of Commerci's Prime Minister.
QuestInfo.1: You travel to the empty house to talk to Leon Daniella, only to discover him being attacked by a bunch of cat-burglars!
QuestInfo.2: You saved Leon Daniella from the cat-burglars, but he wasn't happy to be helped.
